renders.title: Complete unit v1 (simplified, everything together)
renders.comment: SIMPLIFIED, not detailed (OpenPocket #311). Frame and braces, solar panel, growing pipe with a pod in each of its 48 holes (4 per level, 100 mm apart, assumed), water tank, seedling tray, seedling storage and the cart on the track. Views: -iso, -front, -top, -side.

renders.title: Whole unit with the track supports
renders.comment: DRAFT, OpenPocket #315 (plan 295 part 1). The unit (tank, spine, collars, top triangle, track loop) with the new supports: a post on the tank lid at each end of the bottom run, 15 mm before the bend, and, on the top run, a short vertical hanger from the grey crossbar down to a block on each side (no diagonal rods; the orange triangle legs are unchanged). All on the M8 rod of the track joint, entering from the spine side (the sleeve's C-gap side). Sag and numbers: docs/bench-test/track_support_sag.txt. 3D model: cad/renders/track-supports-assembly.glb. Views: -iso, -front, -top, -side.

renders.title: Bottom run support (close-up)
renders.comment: DRAFT, OpenPocket #315 (plan 295 part 1). Post on a small base plate on the tank lid, M8 rod into the pipe (nut plate inside), lock nut outside. The cart rolls to home (roll 0) to pass it, same interlock as the joint rods. With the centre bracket the bottom run is held at three points. Sag and numbers: docs/bench-test/track_support_sag.txt. 3D model: cad/renders/track-supports-assembly.glb. Views: -iso, -front, -top, -side.

renders.title: Top run hanger (close-up)
renders.comment: DRAFT, OpenPocket #315 (plan 295 part 1). Sag and numbers: docs/bench-test/track_support_sag.txt. 3D model: cad/renders/track-supports-assembly.glb. Views: -iso, -front, -top, -side.

renders.title: Whole cart assembly v4 (rigid base, omni hands)
renders.comment: DRAFT, OpenPocket #280 (plan 265 part 6). The cart as now designed: rigid plate bolted to both sleeve pads (no hinges), the two three-lobe omni sleeves each with a drive and a roll motor, battery under the arm, folded SO-101 envelope. renders.title: Cart wheel pairs: both hands on two pipes v1
renders.comment: DRAFT, drawing 4 of 5. Context view: the cart's two hands, one clamped on each of two parallel pipes (pipe B and pipe C of neighbouring units), 280 mm apart. Each hand has six wheels in three rigid pairs 60 mm apart: one driven pair (-X, worm drive and motor) and two spring idler pairs. Assumed, not decided: pipes 280 mm apart (as cart_arm.py), carrier plates, 623ZZ bearings, 60 N springs per wheel, worm drive, motor 28 x 55 mm; full list at the top of cad/cart_wheel_pairs.py. Top and side views: cart-wheel-two-hands-v1-top.png, cart-wheel-two-hands-v1-side.png.

Assumed, not decided: pipes 280 mm apart (as cart_arm.py), carrier plates, 623ZZ bearings, 60 N springs per wheel, worm drive, motor 28 x 55 mm; full list at the top of cad/cart_wheel_pairs.py. Section view: cart-wheel-corner-v1-section.png.

renders.title: Cart base on two pipes v1
renders.comment: DRAFT, drawing 2 of 5. The base plate across two parallel pipes (pipe B and pipe C, one from each of two neighbouring units), one hand sleeve bolted on each pipe (M4 pairs from hand_sleeve.py), SO-101 arm mount at the plate centre (4 x M4 on a 50 mm square plus a cable hole), battery cross bars with corner stops and strap slots, a saddle for each drive motor, and cable tie slots in the rim for the 12 V, motor and USB leads. Assumed, not decided: pipes 280 mm apart, plate 112 x 380 x 6 mm open frame, arm hole pattern, battery 70 x 50 x 70 mm and its fixing, motor and saddle design, cable routes. Views: plan (cart-base-v1-plan.png), top and side (cart-base-v1-top.png, cart-base-v1-side.png). Shared numbers come from cart_arm.py.

renders.title: Cart sleeve systems v2
renders.comment: DRAFT, drawing 3 of 5. v2: each hand (each set of wheels) is on its own pipe: two parallel 32 mm pipes, one hand on each, instead of both hands on the same pipe. Sleeves (hand_sleeve.py v4.1), two wheel rows 60 mm apart, driven wheels (180 deg), spring idlers (+/-60 deg, arrows = 60 N preload), C-gap with funnel (18 mm narrow, 30 mm mouth), and a worm-gear motor on each hand. Clamping is by the spring idlers only: v4.1 has no jaw, so there is no open/closed view yet. Assumed, not decided: pipes 280 mm apart (as cart_arm.py), one worm shaft per hand meshing both driven axles, 28 x 55 mm motor, axle pins, bearing blocks. Front, side and top views with dimensions: cart-sleeves-v2-front.png, -side.png, -top.png.
